note: BH-9407: the waits before each retry of a failed pool `machines list` call, one space-separated number per retry (default: 3 retries, 4 calls). Only timeout, api and other failures are retried; auth, app-not-found, rc 126/127 and rc-0 answers are not. Empty = no retry. Read by pool_list_backoff as ${POOL_LIST_RETRY_BACKOFF_S-2 5 15}; "2 5 15" is the code fallback named by this knob. A value with a non-number is logged and falls back to "2 5 15".
